summary.ja: 飲み物を注文して、サイズや支払い方法を伝える。
summary.en: Order a drink, choose a size and pay.

setting: A busy café in a city abroad where English is the shared language (it could be London, Bangkok or Lisbon). Morning, a short queue.

roles.persona: A Japanese traveller ordering a drink.

levels.tutor: You are the barista. Speak slowly, in short simple sentences, and ask one thing at a time. Offer easy choices ("Small, regular or large?").

hints: 飲み物を注文しましょう
サイズを伝えましょう
カードか現金か伝えましょう

levels.tutor: You are the barista. Speak at a natural but clear pace. Ask about size, then whether they want anything else, and answer questions about the Wi-Fi (the password is on the receipt).

hints: 飲み物を注文しましょう
Could I get a hot coffee, please?
サイズを伝えましょう
Wi-Fiが使えるか聞きましょう
Is there Wi-Fi I can use?
カードか現金か伝えましょう

levels.tutor: You are a friendly, chatty barista. Speak at natural speed, add a little small talk, and ask whether it's for here or to go.

title.ja: 飲み物をカスタマイズして注文する

hints: ミルクの種類なども伝えて注文しましょう
Could I get a latte with oat milk, please?

title.ja: 店内か持ち帰りか伝える

hints: 店内で飲むか持ち帰るか伝えましょう
Wi-Fiについて聞きましょう
支払い方法を伝えましょう

twist.tutor: Apologise: the card machine has just stopped working, so it's cash only for now. Let them work out a solution (there's an ATM next door, and phone payments still work).

title.ja: 支払いのトラブルを解決する

hints: 困ったことを伝えて、解決策を聞きましょう
I don't have much cash. Is there an ATM nearby?

levels.tutor: You are a customer who isn't sure what to order. Speak slowly and simply, and wait for the barista to ask you things.

hints: サイズを聞きましょう

levels.tutor: You are a customer at natural pace. Order a latte, and ask about the Wi-Fi.

hints: What can I get for you today?
サイズを聞きましょう
パスワードの場所を伝えましょう
The password is on your receipt.
支払い方法を聞きましょう
Will that be card or cash?

levels.tutor: You are a chatty customer who can't decide: ask for a recommendation and change your mind once.

hints: What can I get started for you?
おすすめを伝えましょう

title.ja: 店内か持ち帰りか聞く
title.en: Ask: for here or to go?

hints: 店内か持ち帰りか聞きましょう
Is that for here or to go?
支払い方法を聞きましょう
How would you like to pay?

prop.title: CORNER CAFÉ
prop.foot: Free Wi-Fi · the password is on your receipt
